instruction: Make Yahoo my default search engine for internet searches.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to change the default search engine to Yahoo. The evaluator uses the existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Same complexity and steps as the original task.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very high - same type of task (search engine change), same number of steps, same interaction pattern

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default search engine name from Chrome Preferences file (chrome.py:200-231)
Metric logic correctly checks if result is in the expected list of Yahoo variants using match_in_list (general.py:50-57)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (Yahoo as default search engine)
Semantic compatibility: getter returns string (search engine name), metric expects string in list - perfect match
Expected values are correct: ['Yahoo', 'Yahoo!', 'Yahoo Search'] cover all valid Yahoo search engine name variants
Postconfig is appropriate: killing and restarting Chrome ensures Preferences file is flushed to disk with updated settings
